title: Gungor 2015: csa anatomical of paraspinal / lumbar extensor mass at L3-L4 (F, supine)
muscle_as_reported: erector spinae muscles (ESM) = ES group + transversospinalis (multifidus, rotatores) + interspinales/intertransversarii

imaging.plane: axial-oblique slice parallel to the intervertebral disc (one per disc level)
imaging.posture_detail: head-first supine, arms at sides, knees slightly flexed on a cushion

quantity.name: csa_anatomical
quantity.definition: anatomical cross-sectional area of the muscle in the image plane (as cut, not corrected for fibre direction)

source.authors: Gungor C, Tang R, Sesek RF, Foreman KB, Gallagher S, Davis GA
source.sample: 112 patients (58 F, 54 M); historical clinical lumbar MRI patient population aged 21-39 (L3/L4 54F/53M, L4/L5 50F/44M, L5/S1 41F/35M)

how_to_simulate: Pose the model supine with slight hip/knee flexion.
Cut a plane through the L3-L4 disc centre parallel to the disc.

Sum the anatomical CSA of all posterior paraspinal elements (longissimus, iliocostalis, spinalis, multifidus, rotatores, interspinales/intertransversarii) crossing that plane, per side (PCSA / cos(angle to plane normal)).
Compare right, left and total with mean +/- SD.
protocol.notes: Patients scanned clinically (historical dataset; not screened as healthy); population was overweight on average (BMI ~27-28).

extraction.check_notes: Table 3 single-line rows; re-read all values against the PDF text.
